{{Exclusive|Year/Seal}} {{Infobox/Item |rarity=e |source=[[Fishing]] |id = BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL |bazaar=BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL |auctionable=no }} A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' is an {{Epic}} item obtained from fishing. It is used to start a minigame about bouncing the ball to obtain {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s. == Obtaining == A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be obtained while {{Skill|Fishing}} anywhere during the [[Year of the Seal]]. It has a {{Green|25%}} ({{Green|1}} in {{Green|4}}) chance to replace a '''{{Purple|GOOD CATCH}}''' or '''{{Purple|GOOD}} {{DarkGreen|JUNK}} {{Purple|CATCH}}'''. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Treasure Chance ! Catch Chance |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|5|icononly=y}} | {{Green|1.11%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|89.9}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|15|icononly=y}} | {{Green|3.34%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|30.0}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|30|icononly=y}} | {{Green|6.68%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|15.0}}) |} When caught, the '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' grants {{Skill XP|+160 Fishing}}. == Usage == A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be used to start a minigame where the player must bounce the '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' off of their head continuously, where each bounce counts towards {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s. Up to {{Item|Fishy Treat|amount=20}}s can be obtained from a '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' after {{Green|40}} bounces. Any bounces past {{Green|40}} will provide no additional treats. A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' cannot be used on the {{zone|Private Island}}, {{zone|The Garden}} or the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}. == Calculation == The number of treats received is calculated depending on the number of bounces, rounded down: {| class="wikitable centertext" |- ! Bounces (n) ! Fishy Treats |- | 0 | 1 |- | 1–3 | n |- | 4–27 | \frac{n+4}{2} |- | 28–39 | \frac{n+20}{3} |- | 40+ | 20 |} If the player has a {{Item|Blended Fish Mixin}} active, the number of treats received is increased by {{Green|3}}. === Calculator === {{Calculator:Fishy Treats}} == Game Messages == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Associated Text |- |When initially using the item |{{Dialogue|&6&lBOUNCE BONANZA!
